title: Germany 30-Year Bund multi-ISIN auction (EUR 2.5bn across two reopening lines) — on CPI day
source: EST: deutsche-finanzagentur.de English issuance calendar (/en/federal-securities/issuances/issuance-calendar), re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 125,468 bytes) — the Quarter IV 2026 table lists TWO 30-year reopening lines dated 14.10.2026, 'Bund 30 Y (R)' at EUR 1.5bn and 'Bund 30 Y (R)' at EUR 1.0bn, both with ISIN, coupon and maturity shown as '-'. CORROBORATED BY A SECOND, INDEPENDENT FINANZAGENTUR PRIMARY published months earlier and untouched since: the H2 2026 issuance outlook workbook (Issuance_outlook_2026_Update_Q3_en.xlsx, HTTP 200, 78,201 bytes, 'As of June 2026'), whose row for 2026-10-14 reads 'Bund | 30 years | Reopenings (multi-ISIN) | 2500'. Two primaries, one date and one size. The dashes are expected rather than missing data: the auction-process page (HTTP 200, 96,570 bytes) states that for multi-ISIN auctions in the 15- and 30-year segment 'the benchmark bonds to be reopened are not finalised until the quarterly calendars are updated' and that the second bond is 'only announced in a press notice in the week before the auction', with all multi-ISIN auctions announced four bank business days ahead — which for Wednesday 14.10.2026 falls on 2026-10-08 (German Unity Day, 3 October, is a Saturday in 2026, so no bank holiday intervenes). Neither of this auction's ISINs is fixed at D-35, where the 09-16 sibling already had 60% of its volume named. Nothing on the Finanzagentur press-release index concerns 10-14 yet; its newest notice is dated September 08, 2026. Filed estimate on the same mechanical count as its proposer and its sibling: market-events-data.ts defines no confirmed source prefix for a non-US sovereign debt office, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. The DATE is not in doubt — the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: Proposed during the bund-30y-auction-2026-09-16 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-09) and researched the same day (docs/research/events/bund-30y-auction-2026-10-14.md); this canonical file replaces the proposal it arrived as. Germany sells EUR 2.5bn of 30-year duration with bidding closing 11:30 CEST (09:30 UTC = 05:30 ET) — about 3 hours before the 08:30 ET CPI print (cpi-2026-10-14, CONFIRMED, high) and 8.5 hours before the Beige Book (beige-book-2026-10-14, 14:00 ET). Tiered `low` and NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED: no house playbook is rates-keyed and no tracked symbol carries euro-rates exposure. The initial research rebuilt the sibling's pipeline from scratch, reproduced its figures exactly where they overlap, and returned the same null — soft-vs-firm bid-to-offer moves the US 30Y CMT +0.01bp (SE 0.69, t = 0.01, n = 204 of 213 dates; the CMT has a 1,455-day hole 2002-02-15 to 2006-02-09 that drops 9) and the Bundesbank 30Y +0.35bp (t = 0.66), with undersubscribed-vs-covered giving +0.25bp US (t = 0.30) and +1.04bp Bund (t = 1.60) against daily sds of 5.47/4.64bp. THREE FINDINGS ARE NEW TO THIS LEDGER. (1) THE PRE-AUCTION CONCESSION IS A COMPOSITION ARTIFACT: pooled T-5 to T-1 on the Bund 30Y is +1.14bp (t = 1.93) against an all-days baseline of -0.10bp, but that lives entirely in the small auctions (+1.26bp, t = 2.01, n = 176); on multi-ISIN dates of EUR 2.0bn or more it is +0.54bp (t = 0.33, n = 37) and on exactly this auction's shape (two lines, EUR 2.5bn, n = 23) it is -1.17bp (t = -0.49), the opposite sign. Eight windows were tested and nothing survives a multiple-comparison correction. (2) THE ALLOTMENT BAND TIGHTENS on a better estimator: 23 identical-shape auctions since 2023 allotted a mean of EUR 2,001m (sd 105, min 1,888, max 2,396) with 21 of 23 inside EUR 1,850-2,100m, and 2026's two ran 1,910/1,906 at 23.6%/23.8% retention against 22.0% for the year — so the registered band is EUR 1,850-2,100m, not the sibling's 1,850-2,200. (3) THE TRIPLING PLATEAUS: Q4 2026 carries only 14.10 and 11.11 and no December 30Y date, putting full-year 30Y auction supply at EUR 33.25bn against 37.0bn in 2025 (-10.1%), the first down year since 2022 — a calendar reading, not an announced cut, and still 2.9x the 2022 trough. The FOMC finding was re-verified on 215 decision days (26 of 213 auction dates collided; US 30Y mean absolute move 3.12bp vs 3.88bp) but does NOT transfer to CPI: the CPI-day base rate could not be computed because bls.gov returned 403 to this session's fetcher, which is recorded in the ledger's probe-ref.blocked and routed to the next pulse rather than guessed. The real long-end supply cluster is 2026-10-08 — treasury-30y-bond-2026-10-08, jgb-30y-auction-2026-10-08, treasury-buyback-20y30y-2026-10-08 and ecb-account-2026-10-08 all land that session, which is also this auction's own announcement date — so unlike its September sibling this auction is NOT part of a synchronised 48-hour long-end block, and the US bond market is shut two days before it (sifma-bond-market-closure-2026-10-12). The 04.11.2026 Bund 15Y pair on the same Q4 calendar is recorded here and not filed: wrong tenor for this ledger's question. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
